about: The .cnl element type each circuitRF kind in classes.json is written as (ComponentTypeRegistry.EngineReference), for crfml.label_to_cnl. paired: the kinds that bind each port as a (+, −) pair, the minus on ground (the system blocks). tail: nets appended after the drawn pins (a via to ground names ground as its second). params: parameters a kind needs to take its pin count (an SPDT is the switch with two throws). Held to the C# side by tests/Ui.Tests/Vision/LabelToCnlTests.
